threads.body: The head recheck is not atomic with this plain push. If the Renovate branch is deleted or moved backward after line 111, Git accepts this as a branch creation/fast-forward, so the workflow can recreate the branch or publish a commit based on a head that is no longer current. Push with an explicit lease for the validated SHA so any head change causes the push to fail.

+name: Renovate data autofix
+
+on:
+  workflow_run: # zizmor: ignore[dangerous-triggers] only validated data patches reach the write-token steps
+    workflows: [Runner]
+    types: [completed]
+
+concurrency:
+  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_branch }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+
+permissions:

+            --arg repository "$REPOSITORY" \
+            --arg sha "$EXPECTED_HEAD_SHA" \
+            '
+              .state == "open" and
+              .user.login == "renovate[bot]" and
+              .base.repo.full_name == $repository and
+              .head.repo.full_name == $repository and
+              .head.ref == $branch and
+              .head.sha == $sha
+            ' <<< "$pull_request"
+          echo "branch=$EXPECTED_HEAD_BRANCH" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          echo "sha=$EXPECTED_HEAD_SHA" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+
+      - name: Check out the trusted workflow code
+        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
+        with:
+          path: trusted
+          persist-credentials: false
+
+      - name: Check out the pull request head
+        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
+        with:
+          fetch-depth: 1
+          path: target
+          persist-credentials: false
+          ref: ${{ steps.pull-request.outputs.sha }}
+
+      - name: Download generated data patches
+        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1

+          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
+          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/renovate-data-patches
+          pattern: renovate-data-*
+          run-id: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}
+

+        id: apply-patches
+        env:
+          PATCHES_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/renovate-data-patches

+          set -euo pipefail
+          python trusted/.github/scripts/renovate_data_patches.py \
+            --repository target \
+            "$PATCHES_DIR"

+            echo "changed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          else
+            echo "changed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          fi
+
+      - name: Recheck the pull request head
+        if: steps.apply-patches.outputs.changed == 'true'
+        env:
+          EXPECTED_HEAD_BRANCH: ${{ steps.pull-request.outputs.branch }}
+          EXPECTED_HEAD_SHA: ${{ steps.pull-request.outputs.sha }}
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests[0].number }}
+          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          pull_request="$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/pulls/$PR_NUMBER")"
+          jq -e \
+            --arg branch "$EXPECTED_HEAD_BRANCH" \
+            --arg repository "$REPOSITORY" \
+            --arg sha "$EXPECTED_HEAD_SHA" \
+            '
+              .state == "open" and
+              .user.login == "renovate[bot]" and
+              .base.repo.full_name == $repository and
+              .head.repo.full_name == $repository and
+              .head.ref == $branch and
+              .head.sha == $sha
+            ' <<< "$pull_request"
+
+      - name: Create an otelbot token
+        if: steps.apply-patches.outputs.changed == 'true'
+        id: otelbot-token
+        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
+        with:
+          client-id: ${{ vars.OTELBOT_SEMCONV_CONFORMANCE_CLIENT_ID }}
+          private-key: ${{ secrets.OTELBOT_SEMCONV_CONFORMANCE_PRIVATE_KEY }}
+          permission-contents: write
+
+      - name: Resolve the otelbot identity
+        if: steps.apply-patches.outputs.changed == 'true'
+        id: otelbot-identity
+        env:
+          APP_SLUG: ${{ steps.otelbot-token.outputs.app-slug }}
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.otelbot-token.outputs.token }}
+        run: echo "user-id=$(gh api "/users/${APP_SLUG}[bot]" --jq .id)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+
+      - name: Commit and push the generated data
+        if: steps.apply-patches.outputs.changed == 'true'
+        env:
+          APP_SLUG: ${{ steps.otelbot-token.outputs.app-slug }}
+          APP_USER_ID: ${{ steps.otelbot-identity.outputs.user-id }}
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.otelbot-token.outputs.token }}
+          HEAD_BRANCH: ${{ steps.pull-request.outputs.branch }}
+        working-directory: target
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          git config core.hooksPath /dev/null
+          git config user.name "${APP_SLUG}[bot]"
+          git config user.email "${APP_USER_ID}+${APP_SLUG}[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
+          git add -- ':(glob)scenarios/**/data.json'
+          git commit --no-verify -m "Update generated data files"
+          gh auth setup-git
+          git push --no-verify origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$HEAD_BRANCH"

The other scenario where renovate PR checks fail is if a scenario lock file is stale.

Updating the lock files is more complicated because it would have to account for each ecosystem.
E.g.:
- https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-conformance/pull/186
- https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-conformance/pull/201

What do you think? Is this something to automate or to be kept for the maintainers?
